name: Ari
description: a young woman with a white chin-length bob with straight bangs whose tips fade to aqua, a plain teal headband, pale skin, large light blue eyes with long lashes, FULL SOFT LIPS, blue teardrop earrings, a gold chain necklace with one large round blue gem pendant in a gold setting resting at the front of her neck (seen from behind, only the bare gold chain crosses the nape - no pendant, no bead, no drop, no clasp hangs at the back), a plain teal headband over the crown that is visible from every angle including from directly behind, an hourglass figure with a full bust, a narrow waist, wide hips and thick thighs.
